title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a Bond albedo of 0.294
summary: The fact sheet lists Earth's Bond albedo as 0.294 and its geometric albedo as 0.434.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a Bond albedo of 0.294 and a geometric albedo of 0.434. The sheet prints both. They are not the same quantity on the page, and this card does not collapse them into one reflectivity.
